path.description: Path inside the skill folder, with '/' separators and no '..'

note.description: What to take from this file (for references: what the picture shows that matters)

SkillFileRole.description: instructions: SKILL.md and files it points a model to; profile: the kind's typed profile; reference: pictures or documents to aim for; example: worked examples; kit: code a page or component may use; check: a check that can be run

id.description: The skill's id: its folder name (loaders fill it in when frontmatter leaves it out)

description.description: When to use this skill, in a sentence or two (shown in catalogs and to models)

kind.description: The skill's kind (see SkillKindSchema). Built-in kinds: 'rule', 'skill', 'style', 'ui-aesthetic'

extends.description: Another skill this one builds on: its id, optionally pinned as 'id@1.2.0'

metadata.description: Free-form frontmatter metadata a package reads, e.g. editor's { kind: 'workflow', reference: '…' }

files.description: Files in the skill, SKILL.md included

contentHash.description: sha256 (hex) of skillContentHashInput(files with their contents); changes whenever any file does
